turns.q: What should I do if the tracking never updates?
turns.replyTail: e best next checks: - Look at the tracking page details—there’s often a reason for the delay shown there, and the estimated delivery date can change based on shipment volume or transit issues. - If your tracking shows Out For Delivery, the carrier may take up to 48 business hours to complete delivery (for example due to weather, road closures, or other unexpected interruptions). - If your order has multiple items, they may arrive on different days and each item will have its own tracking number.

turns.q: My tracking says delivered but I didn't receive it, what now?
turns.replyTail: ows Delivered but you didn’t receive it, here’s what to do: - Scroll through your tracking details (including the carrier’s site) to confirm all items were delivered—larger orders often ship separately, so some pieces may still be in transit and arrive within 1–2 business days. - Check around your home (front porch, side door, garage, carport), since packages are sometimes left in discreet spots. - Check with neighbours in case it was accepted for safekeeping or dropped off next door by mistake.
